items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And they had another piano player around there named Pickett, he married the chi-chi girl, Rose Murphy.

ctx.x: Lannie Scott went to New York, didn't he?

Yeah, he played with Jonah Jones for a long time. And they had another piano player around there named Pickett, he married the chi-chi girl, Rose Murphy. He was a fantastic player. He died. He was a good piano player. They all used to play together around there, you know. And this -- my mother came and got me and made me go back to Columbus and finish school.
And then, that's when these fellows, Je ter and Pillars came through Columbus. And --
